title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19
lineage: 1st generation Reels (Akai GX-625)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell UD35-90B)

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard recording that captures strong moments like Cumberland, Estimated and Stella, but suffers from mix issues and uneven energy.
ai_review.review: The SBD source delivers generally clear and balanced audio, praised by most listeners as “crisp” and “amazing”. While several reviewers hail the show as awesome with standout performances of Cumberland, Estimated and a solid Stella, one detailed account notes flat first‑set playing, weak mixes, and Phil’s near‑absence until late in the second set. Overall the performance is enjoyable but inconsistent, and the recording needs a touch of EQ to tame occasional muffed sections.

ai_rating.rationale: Three 5‑star reviews praise both show and sound, while one detailed 2‑star review points out significant mix and performance flaws; the average star rating is 4.25, leading to a solid 4.3 overall.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and clear with soundboard fidelity; occasional mix imbalances, muffed patches (e.g., in Truckin'), and a need for light EQ to smooth out harsh frequencies.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as flat and mix‑troubled, second set shows occasional spikes (Stella, Estimated) but remains uneven; overall pacing feels inconsistent.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s tone is praised as perfect/crisp early on, though he searches for better tone during Franklin's Tower.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh is largely absent in the first set and barely audible later; his Space improvisation is considered weak.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir’s vocal dramatics (e.g., “Bobby’s Slide Practice™”) are noted, with some criticism of over‑the‑top delivery on Good Lovin'.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland shines on Estimated and in the Jer songs; early mix makes keyboards hard to hear.
